policy: All 18 listed consoles must play offline from a single installer containing their native emulators and required assets. No downloads of emulator applications, cores, or firmware after installation; separately approved in-app core updates remain optional. Require real video, sound, input, saves and long-run testing on each platform before release.

offline_runtime_evidence.statement: All 4 actual installer lab jobs passed against staged native binaries; source-built and native runtime proof only, no real-game, physical install, or license approval.

evidence_notes: Four-platform staged installer native runtime selection proven for 18/18 system profiles and 11/11 SHA-256 matched cores per platform, from successful GitHub Actions run 42448004780 (commit 2b6e0c68). Two exact standalone setup/download flags now true; game video, audio, physical clean-install, NGP mono sound, cross-core legal compatibility, corresponding binary source, and release approval remain UNVERIFIED. Do not publish 3.0 until independent release gates succeed.
